title: John Chrysostom on Ecclesiastes 1:2
body: “Serve God with tears, that thou mayest be able to wash away your sins. I know that many mock us, saying, "Tears directly." Therefore it is a time for tears.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
bodyEs: “Sirve a Dios con lágrimas, para que puedas lavar tus pecados. Sé que muchos se burlan de nosotros, diciendo: "Lágrimas en seguida." Por eso es tiempo de lágrimas.”

title: John Chrysostom on Ecclesiastes 7:2
body: “It is of great benefit even to see the poor. "It is better," he saith, "to go to the house of mourning, than to the house of feasting." (Eccles.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on Galatians through Philemon
bodyEs: “Es de gran provecho incluso ver a los pobres. "Mejor es", dice, "ir á la casa del luto que á la casa del convite." (Ecl.”
